description: Bruitages du monde Brigade de déminage (dossier /61/ des cartes SD).

sons.prompt: Tense military briefing sting, low brass hit and a ticking clock, bomb squad intro
Tense bomb defusal ambience, loud steady mechanical clock ticking, low electronic hum, seamless loop
Electronic disarm sound, relay click followed by a descending double beep
Harsh electronic error buzzer with a short electrical crackle
Single short sharp electronic beep, metronome
Big cinematic explosion, deep boom and debris, then ringing silence
Bomb timer powering down with a falling tone, then a relieved soft orchestral chord
Urgent electronic alarm, fast rising beeps, bomb warning
